intro: AI is useful for growing income only when it knows you. Run these five prompts in order in one conversation. The plan is a starting point to test, not a promise.

free.title: Prompt 1: What you already have
free.body: Copy this inInterview me, one question at a time, about my skills, experience, the problems people already ask me to help with, my audience or network, my time and my budget. Then summarize what I have to work with.

free.title: Prompt 2: One offer, one channel
free.body: Copy this inBased on everything you know about me, what is the most realistic way for me to reach [income goal] in the next 6 months? Limit it to one offer and one channel. Tell me why, and what would make it fail.

free.title: Prompt 3: Who to learn from
free.body: Copy this inWho are 3 people or businesses that have done something like this well? What did they do in their first 90 days that I can learn from? Tell me where I can verify each one.

free.title: Prompt 4: The 90-day plan
free.body: Copy this inWrite a simple 90-day plan for this offer: what to do each week, the one number to track, and what "working" looks like at day 30, 60 and 90. Keep it under 5 hours a week.

free.title: Prompt 5: Find your blocker
free.body:
Copy this inI'm stuck at [where you're stuck]. Ask me questions until you can name the one thing holding me back, then give me the smallest next step to get past it this week.

No plan guarantees income. Test small, track the numbers and adjust.
